data.name: Dutta
data.gender_notes: Dutta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘datta’, meaning ‘given’ or ‘giver’. The name Dutta is a title given to those who selflessly serve and devote themselves to God or a deity. In Hindu mythology, Dutta is the name of several gods and goddesses, including the god of knowledge, Dattatreya, and the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. The name Dutta carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dutta usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies selfless service and devotion to the divine.
data.etymology: Dutta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dutta total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

This name is also used in various Hindu art forms, such as literature and music, emphasizing the spiritual and giving nature of the name.
